source: STEER Project (Save the Children, iDE Cambodia, and the Cambodian Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries) - "Guide on Banana Cultivation Techniques" (សៀវភៅណែនាំស្តីអំពី បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះដំណាំចេក), February 2020
text:
During banana's first year, while the canopy is still small, the wide spacing between plants leaves unused ground that can be planted with fast-cycle vegetables such as eggplant or cabbage, giving farmers an additional income stream from the same land while the banana stand matures. This intercropping period ends once the banana canopy closes and shades out the ground crop.

On sloped land, the guide recommends contour-based planting and soil conservation practices to reduce erosion and retain rainfall on-site, since Cambodia's banana-growing areas include upland and hillside plots where topsoil loss can otherwise be significant.
